scoring_justification: Mass ratio is recomputed from m_surface and m_bulk columns at n=0.99 and compared to the paper-reported value; surface mode thresholds are compared directly to paper-reported gold values. Tolerance details are defined in the individual steps.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference values for effective mass ratio and surface mode thresholds extracted from the paper; these values are not exposed to the agent.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text and figure (explicit statements: mass ratio at n=0.99, threshold fillings at (0,0) and (π,π)).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's headline quantitative results, serving as reproduction targets.

outputs.description: CSV with layer-resolved effective masses; checker recomputes mass ratio at n=0.99 from m_surface and m_bulk columns.
Critical filling values at which a surface mode appears at (0,0) and (π,π) points.

output_contract.notes: Checker recomputes mass ratio from effective_masses.csv columns and compares threshold_n values in surface_mode_thresholds.csv to the internal reference values.
